source: docs/2026 LCY EHS Dash Board.xlsx (SHA-256 0B94C09BEDF3C343D3250496780A2D3B66671B55741ABA0391FDE81BE8B51C10), sheet 'Behavior' ('PARETO Of Behaviors Involved in Accidents', A1:C31; categories A4:A27, counts B4:B27)
notes: Load with: python -m app.safety.behavior.legacy_import check|plan|apply <this file>. Requires migration 0008. Not applied by any migration.

Year: the owner decided (2026-10-08) that all current-year Safety analytical data in the workbook is 2026 data, including Behavior. The sheet labels its denominator 'Total Number of Incident Reports 2025' (A30), but B30 is =Dash!O41, the 2026 Incident total (41). The counts are therefore stored as 2026; the '2025' label is kept here as a recorded source discrepancy.
Counts are annual category totals (typed values in B4:B27). The workbook has no monthly Behavior values; none are invented and the annual counts are not spread over months.
Blank source cells (B12, B13, B16:B27) are null and are not written; they stay unreported, not 0. The sheet's 0% in C12:C27 comes from formulas over those blanks and is not a source fact.
Behavior values are tags: one incident may carry several, so the total of 44 tags exceeds the 41 incidents and is not a reconciliation failure.

Not imported: B29 (=SUM(B4:B28), 44, recorded as expectedTotal), B30 (=Dash!O41, 41; the platform uses its stored Incident total as the denominator instead), B31 (=B29/B30) and the percentages C4:C29 (=Bn/B$30), all recalculated by the platform.
Display names keep the workbook labels except A20 'PPE Respiritory', shown as 'PPE Respiratory', and A24 'Pushing & Pulling ' (trailing space trimmed). sourceLabel keeps each label verbatim.

statedIncidentReports.statedIn: Behavior!B30 'Total Number of Incident Reports 2025' (=Dash!O41; label year is a source discrepancy, the value is the 2026 Incident total)
